**Severity:** error · **Area:** Resume (`RV2xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Cannot resume: module reference {id} names two different files — {file} (imported by {importer}) and {otherFile} (imported by {otherImporter}); two installed copies of one package share the id: dedupe the package so every importer loads one copy (`npm dedupe` / `pnpm dedupe`, or Vite `resolve.dedupe: ["{package}"]`)
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Install one copy of the package for every importer: run `npm dedupe` / `pnpm dedupe`, align the version ranges that pulled in the second copy, or list the package in Vite `resolve.dedupe` so every importer resolves to the root copy.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
// node_modules/fmt@1 and src/admin/node_modules/fmt@2: one id, two files
import { fmt } from "fmt";
export function A() { return <List format={fmt} />; }
```

```tsx prefer
// one node_modules/fmt for every importer (npm dedupe, or resolve: { dedupe: ["fmt"] })
import { fmt } from "fmt";
export function A() { return <List format={fmt} />; }
```

## When it is reported

Client build of the Vite plugin (vite-plugin-rivet), resume mode: an import module reference id names the package specifier, so two installed copies share it and the browser would resume every page with one copy's value. Two paths of one real file (symlinks, `resolve.preserveSymlinks`) are one file. Development SSR warns instead (`resume module reference <id> is stamped with two different values`). Not a compiler diagnostic: needs a project build.
